note: Labelled addresses for weight calibration. `expect` is the worst band this address should produce. A blue chip scoring above its label is a false positive, which is the failure mode that makes a security tool unusable. Add known-bad addresses as you find them; see docs/verifying-weights.md for where to source them. Cases below ease.org were confirmed by hand on the explorer on 2026-09-09: holder count, market cap, price and website checked before labelling. Nothing here was labelled from a model's guess.

cases.label: LINK on Base (wrong chain)
cases.why: LINK's Ethereum address queried against Base, where nothing is deployed at it. Exercises no-market. This is the wrong-chain-id mistake, which is common and expensive

cases.label: AA (Astra)
cases.why: Added on 2026-09-09 to exercise pool-age, when its only pool was 1.3 days old and it scored MEDIUM 50. Past the 48-hour window pool-age correctly switched off, which is what it was added to show. It was labelled clean on the assumption that nothing else would fire, and that was wrong: its only pool holds $1,313 across two transactions, so thin-liquidity fires for LOW 30 and is right to. A position of any size cannot be exited against $1,313 of depth. The label was the error, not the signal. Time-relative signals cannot be pinned to a fixed address; use scripts/find-candidates.ts for a fresh one, and packages/signals/test/behavioural.test.ts for the deterministic case.

cases.label: LAPTOP
cases.why: unverified, pool two days old, thin liquidity, few holders, and a deployer 8 days old with 8 contracts in its entire history. Exercises deployer-history. A second token with the same symbol was deployed by a different fresh address in the same week

cases.label: USDC on Polygon
cases.why: Regression case. Scored HIGH 66 on 2026-09-11 while the same token scored LOW 32 on Ethereum, because holder-concentration was calibrated on Ethereum and a hundred Polygon transfers span seconds rather than days. Measured at 8 seconds for the sample. Polygon has no Uniswap V3 subgraph in our map, so the four market signals cannot run and the liquidity evidence that would have argued against the finding is absent. Must stay at or below low.
